stem: Zara's class is writing short notes about human life stages. She must choose one note about adolescence.

options.text: Adolescence is the human stage between childhood and adulthood, generally from about 10 to 19 years, when the body gradually reaches reproductive maturity.
Adulthood is the stage between childhood and full maturity, generally from about 10 to 19 years.
Everyone begins adolescence on their tenth birthday and finishes on their nineteenth birthday.
The body must already be reproductively mature before adolescence begins.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Adolescence is the stage between childhood and adulthood; maturity develops during it, and the ages are approximate.

teacher.key_rationale: Adolescence is the childhood-to-adulthood stage, roughly ages 10–19, when reproductive maturity develops.
